The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Entirely invented (synthetic) learning-garden trial records supplied in the public fixture.
- Reports a learner recall outcome.

## Exclusion criteria
- Records outside the supplied synthetic fixture.
- Records without a recall outcome.

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 | invented-index (supplied fixture `fixture-001.json`) | records loaded verbatim | 2 hits
- No live backend searches were run. The domain is entirely invented, so OpenAlex, arXiv, and Europe PMC hold no relevant records.

## Screening
Both fixture records met the inclusion criteria and were included.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (Vale, 2024).
